verdict.rationale: Docs show segmentation via tags, saved segments, and date-range filters on subscriber fields (bento-docs-8), combined with behavioral event tracking (bento-docs-1) and flows built from behavior/events/tags (bento-docs-9), which together enable dynamic, attribute+behavior-based audience segments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation stating segments automatically re-evaluate/update in real time as data changes, and independent/hands-on corroboration of live segment behavior.
